name: Master of All Forms [Psionic]
body:
No longer inhibited by a single form, you are able to instantly change into the perfect shape for your current dilemma.

Prerequisites: Swift Shapeshifter*, ability to manifest metamorphosis

Benefit: When you manifest minor metamorphosis, major metamorphosis or metamorphosis the manifestation time is a swift action instead of a standard action.
